title: "The Chase" Goes on a Treasure Hunt Around Europe
summary:
A popular British quiz show is packing its bags. ITV Studios has announced "The Chase Around the World," a new spin-off of its game show "The Chase," Variety reports. It is one of 10 new show ideas the company will present at Mipcom, a big international TV market where companies buy and sell shows.

In the new series, six pairs of contestants race to track down The Chasers, six quiz experts known as some of the biggest brains in Britain. The Chasers will be hiding in secret locations across Europe. Along the way, the teams must solve puzzles. The winning pair then tests its knowledge against The Chasers for a chance at a life-changing prize. The show will have six hour-long episodes on the British channel ITV.

The slate includes plenty of other ideas. In "Expedition Into the Wild," a hit in Sweden, eight celebrities from the city with almost no survival skills spend 18 days in a remote natural area. Working in pairs with basic tools and little food, they must build shelters and complete survival challenges.

"Celebrity Escape," made in New Zealand, follows seven comedians as they work together to solve the puzzles and clues of a new escape room in each episode. In "Next on the Menu," four food superfans compete to create a new dish for a famous restaurant chain.

Nature fans can look forward to "Secret Garden," narrated by David Attenborough. Each episode follows one garden over a long period to capture animal behavior rarely seen by people, from raising families to surviving the changing seasons.

The lineup also includes "70 Up," the final chapter of the famous documentary series "7 Up."
why_it_matters: The announcements show what kinds of family quiz, puzzle and nature shows may soon reach TV screens around the world.
